b3_defects.description: printer_01 is floating horizontally in mid-air near the bookshelf/lamp without physical support.
In the overhead view (Image 6), multiple instances of desk and chair setups overlap spatially, suggesting incorrect layering or cloning errors.

worst_object.reason: A large rectangular object is suspended physically impossible in mid-air near other furniture.

comment: While the room layout and basic proportions are generally comprehensible, immersion is significantly broken by physics errors such as floating objects. Additionally, lighting appears too uniform lacks realistic directional cues to sell a natural daylight environment.
